title: X_RADIAL_LAW_POPULATION_TEST
question: Does X(r) = V_dark^2(r) / V_bar^2(r), computed at every measured SPARC radius across all 175 galaxies and binned in r/R_outer, rise monotonically from a baryon-dominated inner regime to a bound-halo plateau matching the sealed CR025 reference, with cross-galaxy convergence at the outer edge, under canonical Lelli mass-to-light ratios and zero per-galaxy fitting?

P1.name: monotonic rise
conditions: Spearman rank correlation between bin index and median X > 0
at least 3 of 4 adjacent bin pairs show rise

P2.name: outer plateau matches CR025 and stays below cosmic

P3.name: cross-galaxy convergence at outer edge
conditions: spread(0.8-1.0) < spread(0.0-0.2) where spread = std-dev of log10(X) across galaxies
at least 3 of 4 adjacent bin pairs show spread decrease

WC3.name: within-galaxy radius shuffle
WC3.specification: Within each galaxy, permute (V_obs, V_gas, V_disk, V_bul) across R values; 1000 seeded trials (seeds 0..999)

WC4.name: galaxy-randomized normalized radius
WC4.specification: For each galaxy, replace rho = R/R_outer with uniform(0,1) draw; 1000 seeded trials (seeds 0..999)

implementation_discipline.primary_statistic: galaxy-equal: per-galaxy bin medians first, then population median across galaxy-bin medians
implementation_discipline.log_spread_positivity: only positive galaxy-bin X values used for log10 std-dev; nonpositive counts reported per bin
implementation_discipline.primary_sample: all 175 SPARC galaxies; quality flags secondary audit only
implementation_discipline.vbar_squared_formula: V_bar^2 = V_gas * |V_gas| + Upsilon_disk * V_disk^2 + Upsilon_bul * V_bul^2

verdict_ladder.PASS: P1, P2, P3 all hold under canonical; WC1 and WC2 hold P1 and P3; WC3 fails P1 in >= 95% of trials; WC4 fails P3 in >= 95% of trials
verdict_ladder.BOUNDARY: P1 holds under canonical Upsilon but at least one of P2, P3, WC1, WC2, WC3, WC4 fails against prediction

rule_9_falsifier: The claim that X(r) rises monotonically with radius across the 175-galaxy SPARC population to a bound-halo plateau matching CR025 sealed reference, with cross-galaxy convergence at the outer edge, under canonical Lelli mass-to-light ratios.
